description: This PHP source file defines the 'Event' class within the OpenCart admin controller startup namespace. The class manages the registration of event listeners based on database entries, setting up event triggers and associated actions for the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Handles loading and registering admin events from the database in the OpenCart startup process.
